claims.claim: All 27 independent weighted stage operators preserve the computational isometry, with the tied leaf edges included.
claims.scope: Physical one-excitation clock-body sector and admitted computational subspace; arbitrary spectators by tensor identity.

claims.claim: Twelve wrong-rail pair penalties, grouped into six barriers, are two-local and become exactly six leaf detunings on the computational graph.
claims.scope: No added qubits, Pauli supports or interaction pairs; 48 coefficients changed.

claims.claim: Residual embedding gives complete-domain isometry error <= (2 beta + |t| beta sqrt(beta^2+a^2))/Delta.
claims.scope: No asymptotic elimination or adiabatic assumption; backbone is not itself invariant.

claims.claim: At Delta=2^20 and T=56*pi, rounding-inclusive complete-domain distance is <1/65536.
claims.scope: Ideal static proposal with only stored coefficient representation error; not hardware noise.

claims.claim: The same tolerance is certified on T +/- 1/65536.
claims.scope: Timed readout still supplied; no permanent capture/latch.

claims.claim: Vacuum and filled-clock states certify full spectral diameter >=12 Delta, and norm >=6 Delta under every scalar energy shift.
claims.scope: This specific physical detuned family; outside-sector states are deliberately included because the chosen budget is the full operator norm.

claims.claim: Any full-norm-C uniform rescaling has declared transfer deadline >=336*pi*Delta/C.
claims.scope: Not a universal clock speed limit, not a no-go for other times or encodings; robust rounded norm lower bound 6 Delta - d.

claims.claim: Physical graph remains nonplanar with 54 qubits, 204 supports, 102 pairs and degree 18.
claims.scope: Weights and penalties do not planarize this graph; no assertion that every 2D chip requires ancillas.

claims.claim: A planar two-port clock plus ordinary SWAP uses four active physical qubits and has norm-one endpoint deadline pi.
claims.scope: Different intermediate semantics; not a serial history compiler or complete execute-capture-renew episode.

claims.claim: Uniform baseline late-time sample gives q approximately 0.746169, exceeding its earlier short-grid maximum.
claims.scope: Not a certified interval, global optimum, or all-time theorem.

claims.claim: Penalty-free planar history encoding, useful matched resource advantage, complete thirteen-step compilation and closed-loop refreshment.
